name: Clabo S.p.A.
summary: Clabo S.p.A. designs, produces, and distributes refrigerated showcases and furniture for the food retail market worldwide. It offers refrigerated showcases for ice-cream and pastry products exhibition and conservation; and furniture for bars, pastry parlors, cafés, and canteens under the ORION, FB, ARTIC, BOCCHINI, and EASY BEST brand names. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jesi, Italy.
